Where the headlines come from

Figures are contested and change. Each headline is our summary; the reporting is theirs.

  • Crackdown toll, January 8–9: The Jerusalem Post, citing TIME and Euronews (estimates range from 3,117 to more than 36,000)
  • Internet blackout: Al Jazeera, citing NetBlocks
  • The school in Minab: Amnesty International and Airwars
  • Executions: The Christian Post, reporting HRANA
